summary.text: Justin Murphy is a Tabernacle, New Jersey attorney and U.S. Navy veteran who won the 2026 Republican Senate primary. He served a term on the Tabernacle Township Committee and has been active in Burlington County Republican politics since 1988. He previously ran for the Republican Senate nomination in 2024, finishing third, and his campaign pledge calls for a flat income tax and abolishing the federal Department of Education.

paragraphs.text: According to InsiderNJ, he was raised in the Pinelands of Southern New Jersey and lives in Tabernacle.
Enlisted in the U.S. Navy at age 17 and served a four-year term aboard the USS Comte De Grasse (DD 974), including six months in the Persian Gulf during the Iran-Iraq war; honorably discharged.
Elected to the Tabernacle Township Committee in November 2000 and served a three-year term; Ballotpedia lists him as a former deputy mayor of Tabernacle.

Active in Republican politics since 1988: vice president of the Burlington County Young Republicans (1994-1997), a member of the county committee (1996-2000) and president of the Tabernacle Republican Organization (1998-2000).
A practicing attorney since 2006, with a practice covering estate, real estate, contracts, energy consulting and EB-5 economic development; his campaign website says he is self-employed.
Ran for the Republican U.S. Senate nomination in 2024 and lost, finishing third with 11.3% of the vote.
Won the June 2, 2026 Republican Senate primary over a field of four.
